name: A French Village
description: The stories of the people of Villeneuve, a fictional subprefecture, in the Jura, in German–occupied France during the Second World War.

videos.title: The Landing (June 12, 1940)
videos.overview: A doctor oversees the birth of a child.

videos.title: Chaos (June 24, 1940)
videos.overview: People from around the region flock to Villeneuve as the mayor receives word that his town is now a center for refugees. Directed by Phillipe Triboit, 2009.

videos.title: Crossing The Line (September 30, 1940)
videos.overview: A telephone line is cut in the village school, which now serves as a barracks for the German occupation.

videos.title: On Earth As It Is In Heaven (October 15, 1940)
videos.overview: An English pilot is shot down by the German occupation.

videos.title: Black Market (November 7, 1940)
videos.overview: A German propaganda film showing a handshake between Adolf Hitler and Philippe Pétain elicits boos at the movie theater.

videos.title: Cold Spell (November 11, 1940)
videos.overview: A leafleting operation has been set up inside the village post office to spread anti-German propaganda.

videos.title: The Lottery (January 10, 1941)
videos.overview: A man dies of natural causes shortly after winning the lottery.

videos.title: Commitment (February 5, 1941)
videos.overview: The local police are on the hunt for a black-market dealer, only to find out that he is an undercover German agent.

videos.title: The Lesson (February 12, 1941)
videos.overview: The director of the school is jailed for the illegal possession of a gun, after the occupation receives an anonymous tip.

videos.title: Your Name is a Little Jewish (March 4, 1941)
videos.overview: The town's sawmill owner who has been doing business with the German occupation is accused of being Jewish.

videos.title: Risk of Death (March 10, 1941)
videos.overview: The identity of the man who sabotaged the Jewish family's crossing is discovered by the German occupation.

videos.title: Deathblow (March 11, 1941)
videos.overview: The German police is getting closer and closer to discovering the members of the network.

videos.title: A Time for Secrets (September 28, 1941)
videos.overview: Marcel and the communist militants conduct a resistance operation but it goes wrong and the French police catch Suzanne.

videos.title: Our Father (October 17, 1941)
videos.overview: While the communist group plans their next move, Daniel comes to Marcel with urgent news.

videos.title: The Stakeout (October 19, 1941)
videos.overview: Lucienne is preoccupied with the news of her pregnancy, and seeks spiritual guidance before making a serious decision.

videos.title: If I Were Free (October 20, 1941)
videos.overview: Suzanne and Marcel are caught in a random roundup of villagers and brought in to be questioned by the Germans.

videos.title: Choice of Weapons (October 23, 1941)
videos.overview: Daniel investigates the disappearance of food supplies to Villeneuve with the help of De Kevern.

videos.title: The Blue Java (October 25, 1941)
videos.overview: The German police have put Marcel under surveillance in an attempt to discover his militants’ network.

videos.title: One Chance Out of Two (October 26, 1941)
videos.overview: Marcel and the communist militants put their plan to assassinate the German Commander into effect.

videos.title: The Choice (October 27, 1941)
videos.overview: In response to the shooting of two officers, the Germans insist that 20 French hostages be executed in reprisal.

videos.title: What Is Your Name? (October 28, 1941)
videos.overview: Yvon is arrested by Heinrich Müller, but refuses to denounce his fellow comrades.

videos.title: For the Sake of Love (October 29, 1941)
videos.overview: Marcel decides to risk it all and go see his son at Daniel’s after he falls ill.

videos.title: The Traitor (October 31, 1941)
videos.overview: Daniel is arrested by Heinrich after helping Marcel escape.

videos.title: Settling Scores (October 31, 1941)
videos.overview: Marcel is now faced with a crucial decision on whether to follow orders or disobey them.

videos.title: The Train
videos.overview: A train carrying rounded-up Jews is forced to stop in Villeneuve.

videos.title: A Day Without Bread
videos.overview: The captive Jews are settled in at the school, but it becomes obvious that food and water supplies are critically low.

videos.title: A Thousand and One Nights
videos.overview: The police are on the hunt after Jules and Crémieux barely manage to evade arrest.

videos.title: An Escape
videos.overview: After the Gestapo’s decision to separate the Jewish families, Daniel decides to resign as major of Villeneuve.

videos.title: The Mission
videos.overview: After a father and daughter escape, the Gestapo takes over supervision and the Jewish families remain separated.

videos.title: The Liberation
videos.overview: Marie successfully helps Hélène escape from the school, but raises the alarm in the process.

videos.title: The Visitor
videos.overview: Daniel and Sarah stumble upon a wounded man in a barn who escaped capture by the Germans.

videos.title: He Is Caught Who Thinks to Catch
videos.overview: Marie brings Vincent to the barn to retrieve his radio equipment so that he can send an urgent message to London.

videos.title: Stolen Kisses
videos.overview: Suzanne’s reappearance puts Marcel in a very bad spot with his group leader, who discovers he lied about executing her.

videos.title: News From Anna
videos.overview: Marchetti is under pressure to hand Crémieux over to the Germans, but insists on carrying out his own investigation.

videos.title: The Mousetrap
videos.overview: Marie’s farm is under surveillance after Crémieux made a deal with Marchetti to have his family released.

videos.title: The Border
videos.overview: Marchetti relinquishes command of the stakeout before realizing that Rita arrived at the farm.

videos.title: Forced Labor
videos.overview: The new mayor of Villeneuve has come out supporting drafting young Frenchmen to be sent off to Germany.

videos.title: A Day For Exchanging Rings
videos.overview: While on the run, Antoine and his new friend Claude end up hiding out at a barn where they meet another draft dodger.

videos.title: Birth of a Leader
videos.overview: Marie confronts Antoine and the other objectors at their mountain camp, and tries to persuade them to join the Resistance.

videos.title: Training
videos.overview: Antoine leads his group in combat training for future resistance action, much to the frustration of his fellow companions.

videos.title: The Arrest
videos.overview: Marcel and Suzanne head into town to warn a Resistance operative of danger, at a huge risk to their own safety.

videos.title: The Move
videos.overview: Marcel, battered after repeated interrogation and torture, wakes up in a cell with other men, including Marie’s son Raoul.

videos.title: The Delivery
videos.overview: Antoine agrees to help Marie try to free the captive Resistance members with a desperate and daring plan.

videos.title: Three Shots
videos.overview: The rescue operation succeeds but at the expense of one of the prisoners, who remains in German custody.

videos.title: A Birth Certificate
videos.overview: Marcel and Daniel are reunited in a prison cell after Daniel is arrested by the French militia.

videos.title: Alsace and Lorraine
videos.overview: The Resistance’s complex and risky plan to parade in Villeneuve for the November 11th anniversary is in motion.

videos.title: The Day After
videos.overview: The Villeneuve population faces severe retaliation for the Resistance’s parade.

videos.title: A Meaning to the World
videos.overview: Marchetti has Marguerite cornered and knows that she is the key to locate Antoine and his group.

videos.title: Paris Liberated
videos.overview: With Allied forces fast approaching, the Resistance convenes to debate its next course of action.

videos.title: The Bridge
videos.overview: Antoine and Suzanne are on the run from the Germans, while the Resistance awaits explosives for the bridge.

videos.title: The Rope
videos.overview: After arresting Antoine and Suzanne, Marchetti hopes their captivity will help his negotiations with the Resistance.

videos.title: On The Platform
videos.overview: The Resistance is reeling from the tragic death of their comrade, while Marchetti awaits a train with the local militia across town.

videos.title: The Man Without a Name
videos.overview: Retreating German soldiers have taken up temporary shelter in the school, while Hortense and Heinrich are interrogated by American soldiers.

videos.title: The Group
videos.overview: Lucienne focuses all her attention on Kurt, who's gravely wounded; meanwhile, the Resistance meets with De Kervern, the new prefect.

videos.title: An Explosion
videos.overview: The standoff at the school continues and despite Antoine's efforts to avoid bloodshed, Anselme is determined to extract revenge on the militia.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: With a disaster avoided, the new town leadership must decide the fate of the militiamen and the collaborators.

videos.title: The Dusk Before the Night
videos.overview: Pressed by his superior to make an example of the militiamen, Bériot must now change his stance.

videos.title: The Law of Desire
videos.overview: The trial continues as planned, but a crucial bit of information is revealed to Larcher that hinders the prosecution.

videos.title: Arrests
videos.overview: Antoine is charged with rescuing Jeannine Schwartz, while Suzanne is instructed to find damaging information on Bériot.

videos.title: Liberation
videos.overview: With Marchetti under arrest and accused collaborators remaining unprotected, the threat of violent reprisals is higher than ever.

videos.title: Behind The Wall
videos.overview: Autumn 1945: The trial of Daniel Larcher begins, and Antoine returns to begin a new life with Geneviève.

videos.title: The Book
videos.overview: Suzanne and Loriot try to teach Gustave the values of his father; Heinrich Müller appears in Villeneuve to testify.

videos.title: Marcel Larcher Street
videos.overview: Bériot has been defeated by his own party; the communists want to win the next elections and set up Marcel as a hero.

videos.title: The Four Resisters
videos.overview: Jeannine pushes Raymond to run for mayor of Villeneuve, but the arrival of an anonymous letter complicates things.

videos.title: The Duty to Remember
videos.overview: Antoine makes a shocking confession at the ceremony honoring the four resisters; Marchetti agrees to testify in Daniel Larcher's favor.

videos.title: The End of the Tunnel
videos.overview: Judgment day arrives for Daniel Larcher and Servier; Marchetti's sentence is carried out.

videos.title: Prisoners of War
videos.overview: A bloody accident at the sawmill sets off a political firestorm.

videos.title: The Strike
videos.overview: Lucienne confronts Bériot about a German soldier he claims to have killed during the war.

videos.title: A Splash of Red
videos.overview: Hortense's worsening condition compels Daniel to take drastic action.
In 1945, Gustave's past comes back to haunt him.

videos.title: The Opening
videos.overview: The opening of Hortense's exhibition is rocked by protests.

videos.title: The Embarkment
videos.overview: Lucienne and Bériot say their final goodbyes.
